meta.title: Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, Coming November 19
meta.subtitle: Featuring 34 New Tracks — Listen to the First Six Singles, Available Today
meta.blurb: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the upcoming official soundtrack album created in partnership with Atlantic Records and launching November 19 alongside Grand Theft Auto VI, is available to pre-save on all major music streaming services, with limited-edition vinyl and CD sets also available to pre-order.

_memoq.alt: Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album art featuring Jason and Lucia leaning on a vehicle against a background of palm trees and the Vice City skyline at sunset.

_memoq.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the upcoming official soundtrack album created in partnership with Atlantic Records and launching November 19 alongside Grand Theft Auto VI, is available to pre-save on all major music streaming services, with limited-edition vinyl and CD sets also available to pre-order. 

With 34 original tracks that capture the electric energy of Grand Theft Auto VI’s world of Vice City and Leonida, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album features a genre-defying roster of the most exciting artists in the world. Listen to the first six singles today, available across all major music streaming services: 

  • Yung Lean – That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin)

  • Travis Scott – RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) 

  • CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy – Sexy Magic  

  • Morgan Wallen – Last Thing You Need  

  • Rauw Alejandro – Macacoa 2000  

  • Keith Richards – Bright Lights, Big City

_memoq.alt: Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album products: vinyl artwork featuring text that reads "Grand Theft Auto" at the top and "6 The Album" on a vehicle window below, vinyl artwork featuring an alligator floating in an inner tube in a martini glass, artwork featuring the Rockstar logo surrounded by an alligator and flamingo, artwork featuring a flamingo inner tube frozen in ice, and a liquid-filled vinyl.

_memoq.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album will also be arriving on vinyl and CD at launch, including three exclusives only available at gtavi-thealbum.com: a limited-edition liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter-edition vinyl, and a CD jewel case. Additionally, get exclusive vinyl disc colorways, each featuring unique new art, at Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target, Urban Outfitters, and indie retailers. 

Stay tuned for more details about the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the dynamic score, the next evolution of in-game radio, and more.
